title: Meadow Assault
description:
Welcome to Meadow Assault, the ultimate multiplayer CO-OP adventure game where teamwork and strategy are key. Join forces with up to three other friends in a dynamic world teeming with possibilities.

• Multiplayer Mayhem: Team up with friends in online CO-OP mode for an immersive gaming experience.
 

• Diverse Cast: Choose from 11 unique characters (+ other customization), each with their own save.

 Keep Your Crops Thriving • Cultivate Variety: Plant a diverse range of crops and vegetables, each with unique needs and rewards.
 

• Harvest for Profit: Sell your bountiful harvest to upgrade your equipment and expand your farm.
 

• Defend Your Yield: Protect your crops from marauding intruders and ensure a prosperous harvest.

 Gather resources • Resource Riches: Explore procedurally generated landscapes
 

• Customize Your World: Shape the environment to suit your needs and preferences, turning the wilderness into your personal paradise.

 Keep the wildlife under control • Nature's Challenges: Confront and overcome the dangers posed by the untamed wilderness.
 

• Master Your Domain: Establish dominance over the local wildlife to maintain balance and safety in your domain.
description_short: Embark on an epic journey of survival and adventure alone or with up to 4 players online. Cultivate crops, trade for upgrades, and battle your way through the dense forest to uncover the mysterious maze and its secrets. But be vigilant, for danger lurks where least expected.
